title: Triplet Assembly
commonMistakes: Using a card that exceeds the target in one position
Checking only that every target component appears somewhere on one card
Stopping after finding a card that already equals the target without considering the rest of the input
Treating an empty selection as valid
followUps: What if fusing added the ratings instead of taking the maximum?
What if each card could be used at most once but the target had more than three positions?
How would you return a smallest selection that produces the target?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
